zones.title: Input
zones.body: Called with {run_id, as_of, tickers[], days_back}. days_back=5 daily, 600 on backfill.

zones.title: Load
zones.body: 400 calendar days of intel.prices_daily per ticker, ordered by date. Enough history for SMA200 and the 52-week range.

zones.title: Compute
zones.body: Pure JS, no API calls: SMA 20/50/200, Wilder RSI14 and ATR14, 20-day volume z-score, 52-week high/low and distance from high, 1/5/20-day returns. Emits the last days_back sessions per ticker.

zones.title: Store
zones.body: Upsert into intel.indicators_daily keyed (ticker, as_of). Returns row and ticker counts to the caller.
